scope: Complete three-chart cover of global symmetric 3-flats with diagonal projection rank 2 and permanent(J+T)=24. No claim of existence or inconsistency.
generation_formula: 24 permutation terms applied to2J+s(2V)+t(2W)+u(2H), then divide permanent coefficients by16 and primitive-integer normalize.
independent_numeric_audit_formula: 16-subset Ryser formula on exact rational matrices.
coverage_argument: Every 3-dimensional flat of diagonal projection rank 2 has a 1-dimensional hollow kernel. Choose an independent pair of diagonal coordinate restrictions and use S4 to take the unordered pair to {0,1}; choose V,W with those diagonal restrictions equal to I2. Choose a nonzero edge of a hollow kernel vector H. The stabilizer S2 x S2 of {0,1} has the three edge orbits 01, 23, and the four cross edges; normalize its representative to 1, compensating a 0/1 swap by swapping V,W. Subtract the pivot-edge multiples of H from V,W, making their pivot entries 0. The tangent equation sum_all_entries=0 eliminates one other off-diagonal entry of each basis vector. All remaining entries are exactly the 16 free parameters. Conversely the displayed three matrices are always independent by their two diagonal pivots and the hollow edge pivot, and their diagonal image has rank 2. Their first permanent coefficients vanish identically; the 31 degree 2/3/4 equations are therefore equivalent to constant permanent 24 on their span.
